description: This file defines configuration setup functions for the Vitest testing framework, specifically for boundary tests. It imports functions and data from other configuration and pattern files, and exports functions to load include patterns from environment variables and to create a customized Vitest project configuration for boundary testing.

methods.name: export function loadBoundaryIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadBoundaryIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns for boundary tests from environment variable 'OPENCLAW_VITEST_INCLUDE_FILE'.

methods.name: export function createBoundaryVitestConfig( createBoundaryVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns a Vitest project configuration object customized for boundary testing, considering environment variables and CLI arguments.
